name: The Bankers Investment Trust PLC
quirks: UK closed-end global equity investment trust (Janus Henderson); primary listing BNKR.L in London quoted in PENCE, BIT.NZ is a thin NZX secondary listing in NZD (arb tight, ~1% premium to the BNKR.L x GBPNZD cross). FY ends 31 OCTOBER; reports in GBP. 10-for-1 share split on 1 March 2021 - pre-FY2021 share counts x10 and per-share figures /10 to compare. FY2023 has no standalone report; recovered from FY2024 comparatives. Valued on NAV-compounding + exit-discount (like AFI.NZ), NEVER an FCF DCF - no capex/SBC/working capital, and NetIncome is mark-to-market. Two NAV bases: debt at fair value (headline, 152.0p at 30-Apr-2026) vs debt at par (148.1p) - the loan notes are worth less than book. Reports live on the manager's Janus Henderson site.
sector: Closed-End Fund / Global Equity Investment Trust
